create_ResetArmSkill: create a ResetArmSkill instance with config, action space, and batch size to reset robot arm joints
use_on_enter: call on_enter to initialize the skill with observations and compute the initial joint delta
check_is_skill_done: check if the arm has reached the rest state by calling _is_skill_done with current observations
call_internal_act: call _internal_act to compute normalized arm actions that move joints toward the rest state
review_ResetArmSkill: review the ResetArmSkill class to understand how it resets robot arm joints to a configured rest state
